_disclaimer: Derived, unofficial relationship index generated by the corpus toolkit. It records RELATIONSHIPS between anchored units and other instruments only - it deliberately contains no provision text, no quotation and no paraphrase of any authoritative text. Resolve each anchor against the authoritative record.
method_note: Similarity figures are whole-provision word-level ratios computed from the corpus's own verified authoritative texts, so each relationship is evidence-based rather than asserted. They measure textual closeness, not legal equivalence.

relations.characterisation: The four-limb launching-State liability formula (launching State; procuring State; State of territory; State of facility) appears in the resolution and is carried into the treaty article with the same structure and closely corresponding wording.
material_differences: The treaty article confines both the duty-bearers and the beneficiaries to States Parties to the Treaty, whereas the resolution is expressed in terms of States generally.
The treaty article extends the locus expressly to the moon and other celestial bodies.
relations.caution: NOT literally identical: measured whole-provision word similarity is below 80% and the beneficiary class differs. For a pre-1967 launch the resolution and the treaty article are therefore NOT interchangeable, which is precisely why a pre-treaty claim cites the resolution.
relations.evidence: Measured against the corpus's own verified authoritative texts on 2026-07-25.

relations.characterisation: Part B established the voluntary registry maintained by the Secretary-General on the basis of information furnished by launching States; the Convention later placed central registration on a mandatory footing.
material_differences: Voluntary furnishing of information under the resolution versus mandatory registration under the Convention.
relations.caution: CORRECTION TO A COMMONLY-STATED CROSS-REFERENCE: the Convention's preamble does NOT expressly recall resolution 1721 B. Verified against the corpus's authoritative text of the Convention on 2026-07-25 - its preamble recalls the Outer Space Treaty, the Rescue Agreement and the Liability Convention only. The express recall of resolution 1721 B appears in General Assembly resolution 62/101 of 17 December 2007.
